svg.aria-label: Circuit diagram of the pet care station: load cell with HX711, water sensor and button module into the FRDM-MCXC444; servo, buzzer and RGB LED driven by it; UART link to an ESP32-S2 that reads a DHT11 and connects to ThingsBoard over Wi-Fi.
svg.text: FRDM-MCXC444 + ESP32-S2. Pins as configured in the firmware (repo main). Power symbols connect by name.
J13 USB to PC: 5 V power, flashing, debug console
other GND pins: J3-4, J3-14, J2-14
E+ red, E− black, A− white, A+ green
R and B not connected (one colour used).
* only if the module has no resistors on it.
every 3V3 symbol on the MCX side → J3-8; 5V → J3-10 (USB 5 V, about 500 mA); GND → any GND pin. The DHT11 takes 3V3 and GND from the ESP32's own pins.
arrows show direction. Polled: HX711 (every 250 ms), water ADC (250 ms), DHT11 (5 s). Interrupt-driven: button (PTD4), UART2 receive and transmit.
on-board LEDs, switches and light sensor; DAC; I2C and SPI. Both boards are powered from USB.
